svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.19.4 Power Supply
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Power Supply

g.text: Battery backup: at least 7 days in
the normal condition, then 4 min of
Smoke detectors in lieu of smoke alarms,
part of the fire alarm system
Sound within the suite at 75 dBA
Smoke detectors in lieu, Sentences (3) and (4)

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Smoke alarms described in Sentence 9.10.19.1.(1) are
installed with permanent connections to an
electrical circuit, with no disconnect switch
between the overcurrent device and the smoke alarm
And, in case the regular power supply is interrupted,
with a battery as an alternative power source that can
continue to provide power for no less than 7 days in the
normal condition, followed by 4 minutes of alarm. See
Note A-3.2.4.20.(9)(a). Except as in Sentences (2) and
Where the building is not supplied with electrical
power, smoke alarms are permitted to be
battery-operated
Suites of residential occupancy are permitted to be
equipped with smoke detectors in lieu of smoke
alarms
Provided they (a) can independently sound audible
signals of 75 dBA to 110 dBA within the individual
suites (see Note A-3.2.4.18.(4)), (b) except as in
Sentence (4), are installed to CAN/ULC-S524, and (c)
form part of the fire alarm system. See Note
Such smoke detectors may sound localized alarms
within individual suites
They need not sound an alarm throughout the rest of the
building.
Drawn: A a room with near walls cut away, ceiling dashed. B a plan with walls cut low. Blue: the circuit.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.19.4. (page 9-98)
